item.title: Seven Galway projects funded under Town and Village Renewal Scheme
item.description: Seven Galway locations have been earmarked for a new lease of life after they were included this week in the latest €26 million investment under the Town and Village Renewal Scheme. item.title: Minor works and ICT grant aid for Galway schools
item.description: Schools across the city and county will share €3.8 million in funding for minor works and ICT grant aid – part of an overall €65 million package announced this week by Education Minister Hildegarde Naughton.
